verdict.rationale: Swell exposes a broad backend API: products, stock adjustments, purchase links, secret-key auth, and official Node/PHP libraries. Custom models generate REST resources that also appear in the dashboard, a single call returns the full store schema, and docs say admin workflows can be built with any framework. However, no evidence explicitly claims UI–API parity, and the probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage evidence for UI features like the theme editor, drag-and-drop category management, reports, and team roles/permissions, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
